entities.name: Fructose-bisphosphate aldolase
observations: The 288-residue query is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt P75089, annotated as fructose-bisphosphate aldolase.
The sequence contains the F_bP_aldolase domain PF01116 across positions 3–287.
The enzyme is annotated as a homodimer and binds two Zn2+ ions per subunit: one catalytic and one structural.

entities.name: FBP aldolase reaction
observations: EC 4.1.2.13 / Rhea RHEA:14729: dihydroxyacetone phosphate plus glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate reversibly forms fructose 1,6-bisphosphate.
The forward aldol-condensation direction supports gluconeogenesis; the reverse cleavage direction functions in glycolysis.

entities.name: Zinc ion
observations: Zn2+ is a required metal cofactor for this enzyme family; two Zn2+ ions are bound per subunit, with distinct catalytic and structural roles.
